summary: All 5 of iteration-1's findings (1 BLOCKING checkpoint-boundary bug, 2 MAJOR concurrency/GATE-0-policy, 2 minor evidence gaps) are genuinely and structurally resolved, independently re-verified against the raw live Hyperliquid API response (146 fills, recomputed sums match exactly, 1 real tied-timestamp case confirmed). One new MINOR finding (F-9): four REQs (A2/D4/E4/E5) lack a dedicated static-grep proof obligation despite strong negative SHALL-NEVER language, though the architecture already structurally satisfies them. No BLOCKING findings in either dimension; spec is ready to proceed to Phase 2 (TDD).
